## Question
What did field-page development surface that must return into the canonical argument/concept/root/path field without undoing the T07 census discipline?

## Context
This is the recursion Frank stipulated: after each register batch, page development can disclose missing relations, sharpen qualifications, expose duplicated offices or surface contradictions. Fold those discoveries back **per batch**, not as one late mega-pass.

The propagated T07 census remains the starting canon, but it is not protected from evidence discovered by actually developing the field. A page-level discovery that changes structure must be routed through the governing authority chain: state the discovered pressure → test it against the ratified quilt/census → update the plan/decision record first where structural → then update affected canonical nodes and consumers. Do not silently create a new concept/root/path because a page draft needed somewhere to put an idea.

Every fold-back must preserve the publication-office law: linear-bearing / supporting-visible / radial-depth / redundant-with-named-carrier. If a developed page reveals that two ratified records duplicate the same operation, surface it explicitly; if it reveals that a merged item really had independent aletheia-work, surface that too.

Use `tools/okf-workspace.py ... effects` before bearing changes and update all declared consumers/return routes. Protected `NOTES.md` remains read-only.

## Done when

Every root/Matheme/Mytheme/Episteme batch has a fold-back entry; each discovered structural pressure has a traceable disposition through plan/census/affected nodes; no new record appears by stealth; no ratified unique operation is lost through page compression; contradictions exceeding batch scope have an explicit ticket/decision rather than being normalized away; and the canonical field remains census-auditable after each fold-back.
title: T22 — P2 — recursive node fold-back
